cooked: Oh, you’re right. I should have checked the BIP-110 node I run. For some reason I assumed the connections it has to Bitcoin Core nodes are longer-lived. It currently has only BIP-110 and spy-node connections, so it’s unlikely to hinder propagation in this case.
